# agentic-core

Shared core for CLI tools: brand config, logs, and guards.

Keywords: shared-types, config, guards, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-core".
- CLI: agentic-core summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-core mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
